title: NOEMA Closed World Event Catalog v0.2
description: Additive closed catalog: all 24 v0.1 types unchanged, plus seven strategic contestation/crime/agreement event types (RFC-0002) and TRADE_CANCELLED (RFC-0127). Worlds pin catalog_version event-catalog/0.1 or event-catalog/0.2; no silent upgrade.

reducer.behavior: Require a registered agent absent from every active world, an existing room, and grants within configuration.
reducer.stateMutation: Mark the agent active in event.world_id, set location, initialize budgets, and add it to the room entity index atomically.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown agent or room, duplicate or cross-world presence, or invalid budget grants.
reducer.sideEffectRule: None. The reducer performs only the stated in-memory canonical state transition.

reducer.behavior: Require the agent to be active at the named room.
reducer.stateMutation: Remove the agent from the room index, clear live location, and mark world presence inactive while retaining history.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject absent agents or a room/location mismatch.
reducer.sideEffectRule: None. The reducer performs only the stated in-memory canonical state transition.

reducer.behavior: Require the agent at the source, a matching exit and destination, resolved conditions, and sufficient exact costs.
reducer.stateMutation: Atomically debit cost_paid, move the agent, and update source and destination room indexes.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject stale location, invalid exit/destination, unmet conditions, or insufficient resources.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No trigger, message, or observation is implicit; each requires a later event.

reducer.behavior: Require the agent still at from_room_id and record an already-resolved movement denial.
reducer.stateMutation: Append an audit reference only; location, membership, and resources are unchanged.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject a stale source location.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No notification or compensating event is emitted.

reducer.behavior: Require co-location, sufficient attention, a fresh observation id, and for INSPECT deterministic visibility and permission.
reducer.stateMutation: Debit attention and create pending observation-request metadata.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject stale location, insufficient attention, duplicate observation id, or failed inspect visibility/permission.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Observation construction and delivery require OBSERVATION_GENERATED and policy-controlled processing.

reducer.behavior: Require co-location, sufficient attention, a fresh observation id, and for INSPECT deterministic visibility and permission.
reducer.stateMutation: Debit attention and create pending observation-request metadata.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject stale location, insufficient attention, duplicate observation id, or failed inspect visibility/permission.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Observation construction and delivery require OBSERVATION_GENERATED and policy-controlled processing.

reducer.behavior: Require an active sender, same-world addressable recipient, fresh id, allowed content size, containment permission, and sufficient exact cost.
reducer.stateMutation: Debit costs and create an immutable QUEUED message record.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject duplicate ids, cross-world recipient, permission or size failure, or insufficient resources.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No live transport or notification occurs in the reducer.

reducer.behavior: Require a QUEUED message, matching recipient, and delivered_cycle equal to event.cycle.
reducer.stateMutation: Mark the message DELIVERED and index it in the recipient inbox.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown, duplicate, recipient-mismatched, or cycle-mismatched delivery.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No live notification occurs in the reducer.

reducer.behavior: Require distinct active same-world parties, fresh id, valid future expiry when present, and proposer ownership of offered holdings.
reducer.stateMutation: Create an OPEN proposal and reserve offered quantities.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject duplicate/self/cross-world trade, invalid expiry, malformed terms, or insufficient holdings.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No message is sent implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require an open unexpired trade, its counterparty as accepter, and ownership of requested holdings.
reducer.stateMutation: Set status to ACCEPTED_PENDING_TRANSFER without moving holdings.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject missing, closed, expired, wrong-party, or underfunded acceptance.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Transfers require explicit RESOURCE_TRANSFER events.

reducer.behavior: Require an open proposal and an authorized rejecting party; deterministic expiry may use the world actor.
reducer.stateMutation: Set status REJECTED, store reason, and release offered reservations.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject missing or closed trade or unauthorized rejection.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No notification occurs implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require an open proposal and that by is its proposer.
reducer.stateMutation: Set status CANCELLED and release offered reservations.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject missing or closed trade or unauthorized cancellation.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No notification occurs implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require distinct existing same-world holders, fresh transfer id, sufficient eligible balance, and matching accepted terms when trade_id is present.
reducer.stateMutation: Atomically debit from_id, credit to_id, release matching reservation, and record transfer.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject duplicates, unknown/cross-world holders, self-transfer, overdraft, or trade mismatch.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No external settlement occurs.

reducer.behavior: Require fresh org id, unique valid members, bounded text, and an active creator included among initial members.
reducer.stateMutation: Create an ACTIVE organization at event.cycle with its memberships.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject duplicate id, duplicate/invalid member, invalid text, or missing creator membership.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No invitation or message occurs implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require an active organization, known nonmember agent, and protocol-authorized authorizer.
reducer.stateMutation: Add active membership with joined_cycle equal to event.cycle.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown/dissolved org, duplicate member, unknown agent, or failed authorization.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No notification occurs implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require an active organization, current member, and protocol-authorized authorizer.
reducer.stateMutation: End active membership at event.cycle and retain reason in history.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown/dissolved org, absent member, or failed authorization.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No resource transfer or notification occurs implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require fresh id, valid room/owner/inventory references, and acyclic containment.
reducer.stateMutation: Create the live entity at event.cycle and add it to the live room index when located.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject duplicates, dangling references, or containment cycles.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No trigger occurs implicitly.

reducer.behavior: Require a live entity and a valid distinct successor when supplied.
reducer.stateMutation: Set destroyed_cycle, mark ARCHIVED or DEAD, and remove live location/inventory indexes while retaining the record.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown/already destroyed entity or invalid successor.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Never hard-delete or implicitly transfer contents.

reducer.behavior: Require a live entity, at least one operation, disjoint set/unset keys, and mutable allowlisted paths; apply in lexicographic key order.
reducer.stateMutation: Update only allowed properties/state keys.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown entity, overlap, immutable/private keys, or invalid values.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Identity, ownership, location, inventory, and lifecycle cannot change.

reducer.behavior: Require an active agent and duration within configured maximum.
reducer.stateMutation: Set or extend wait_until_cycle deterministically to event.cycle + cycles.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject inactive agents or excessive duration.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Does not advance the world clock.

reducer.behavior: Require sufficient current holding, fresh action/resource key, and remaining equal to current minus amount.
reducer.stateMutation: Debit once and record the consumption key.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject overdraft, duplicate key, stale balance, or arithmetic mismatch.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No provider or tool call occurs.

reducer.behavior: Require available equal to current holding, requested greater than available, and a fresh rejection key.
reducer.stateMutation: Record rejected action and reason in audit state only; budgets and canonical world state are otherwise unchanged.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject stale available value, non-exceeding request, or duplicate key.
reducer.sideEffectRule: The attempted action MUST NOT be applied, called, queued, or charged.

reducer.behavior: Require fresh situation id, existing targets, named seed stream, finite scores, and deterministic score reproduction under versioned configuration.
reducer.stateMutation: Add active situation metadata and target-room references.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject duplicate id, unknown room, score mismatch, or unnamed nondeterminism.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Concrete entities and noise require separate events.

reducer.behavior: Require a pending observation for the agent, fresh id, allowed paths/operations, and reproducibility from the named seed stream.
reducer.stateMutation: Attach immutable noise-decision metadata to the pending observation.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown observation, forbidden/private paths, decision mismatch, duplicate id, or unnamed nondeterminism.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Canonical world state is not edited.

reducer.behavior: Require a matching pending request, ordered existing sources, fresh digest record, and matching noise metadata when supplied.
reducer.stateMutation: Mark observation generated and index its digest for replay and research.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject unknown request/source, duplicate digest record, ordering mismatch, or noise mismatch.
reducer.sideEffectRule: Does not deliver/export data or mutate canonical rooms/entities/private agent state.

reducer.behavior: Pure reducer for CONTEST_DECLARED; see docs/EVENT-CATALOG.md and RFC-0002.
reducer.stateMutation: Apply only the mutations defined for CONTEST_DECLARED.
reducer.rejectionRule: Reject on schema or precondition failure; no partial apply.
reducer.sideEffectRule: No I/O, wall-clock, unseeded RNG, or second ledger append.
